title: Song import document v2
description: One Song work with its Arrangements, carried as the song-import kind of an .ordo file. Arrangements carry reusable sections (each a list of slides, each a list of lines) and a Sequence of section ids. Arrangement content_sha256 is the SHA-256 of every line in section order, then slide order within a section, each line followed by LF. Every sequence entry names a section of the same Arrangement. Optional members are omitted, never null. Ids must be unique within the document (not expressible in JSON Schema; the Rust validator reports a duplicate as a schema finding).

id.description: Stable UUIDv4 of the Song work. Importing the same id again addresses the same Song.

title.description: Primary title of the Song work.

aliases.description: Alternative titles for the Song work.

composer.description: Who the Song work is originally attributed to.

source.description: Where the Song work came from (provenance).

rights.description: Rights notes for the Song work.

liturgical_moments.description: Liturgical moments the Song work belongs to, such as Entrance.

occasions.description: Occasion tags for the Song work.

arrangements.description: Arrangements of the Song work; at least one.

text.description: Text with at least one non-whitespace character.

line.description: One lyric line: no line break, at least one non-whitespace character.

title.description: Arrangement title; omit to let Ordo label it from languages and Choirs.

languages.description: At least one language, by the display name or another name of one of Ordo's built-in languages (docs/contracts/README.md section 13).

choirs.description: Choir names that use this Arrangement; matched to existing Choirs, created when missing.

translator.description: Translator; stored as the rendition attribution.

adapter.description: Adapter; stored with the translator as the rendition attribution.

extraction_warnings.description: Doubts the extracting tool wants the reviewer to see. Shown during review, never stored.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every line in section order then slide order, each followed by LF.

sequence.description: Performance order as section ids; a section may repeat.

id.description: UUIDv4 of the section, unique in the document. Ordo mints its own local section ids.

label.description: Section name such as Koro; omit for an unlabeled section.

slides.description: Slides of the section; a slide is one projected screen of lines.
